api-minimal.description: A small hardened HTTP API: security headers, CORS (deny by default) and rate limiting.

rest-api.description: Hardened REST API with PostgreSQL and generated OpenAPI docs.

saas-backend.description: Accounts, login and a database: JWT auth with email and password, PostgreSQL, Redis-backed rate limiting.
